body:
Greg's rule, 2026-11-12 about 19:24Z, relayed by Engram::Asistant (TermAl mailbox 588693a8 #1454), verbatim: „nie jestem w stanie monitorowac wszystkich sesji, generalnie komunikacja z agentami jest przez twoja sesje”.
Asistant's operative reading: treat Engram::Asistant (session-15908) as THE main channel to Greg. Send there every status that needs his attention, every question, signal and instruction. Never assume he sees other sessions or Advisor. To check that a message arrived and was handled, use proper acknowledgements, not the mere send. Keep working without needless questions.
Consequences for TermAl:
(1) Every Greg act (restart, cutover, install decision) goes to Asistant first, in plain words. Advisor gets a copy where CLAUDE.md's restart clause names it.
(2) Done means Greg replied, not "message sent" or "acknowledged by a relay".
(3) Context: the 2026-11-12 cutover signal went only to Advisor and never reached him (w-bebbae70639c; memory rules-waits-and-wakes-greg-act-holds-2026-11-12).
